description: This file defines a PHP class named SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateTaskButton that extends an existing button class for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It provides methods to generate a form for creating a new Task record from a subpanel, and to display the button itself, including handling of focus object data and form fields.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateTaskButton
classes.description: A class extending SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate, designed to create a button for adding a new Task from a subpanel in the CRM interface.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates an HTML form for creating a new Task record, embedding relevant focus data and additional form fields for submission.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML for displaying the create Task button if the user has edit access.
